name: popover
title: Popover
summary: A small panel anchored to its trigger, with a title, content and a close button.
description: A small raised surface anchored to its trigger: title, description, body and a close button. Click opens it, Escape or a click outside closes it, and focus moves in and returns to the trigger. Behaviour comes from the Zag popover machine, through Ark UI in React, Vue and Svelte.

anatomy.description: Layout-neutral hook around the trigger (display: contents)
aria-haspopup=dialog, aria-expanded, data-state=open|closed. The default trigger is a Button. Marked data-popover="trigger".
Placed by the engine; rendered in a portal. Exposes --transform-origin and --available-height

role=dialog surface composing the shared popup surface (`lib/popup.ts`: surface, motion, keyboard-instant; stacking from base.css); data-state=open|closed. Keeps its own width, 12px padding and a 480px limit (--popup-max-height).
A Button: ghost, size xs, square, shape rounded, muted, aria-label=Close, with a tooltip of the same text. Only its placement is the popover's. Marked data-popover="close".

placement.description: Preferred side; flips when there is no room.

triggerLabel.description: Renders a default Button trigger with this label. Otherwise pass your own trigger.

slots.trigger: Your own trigger element (React `trigger` prop, Vue `trigger` slot, Svelte `trigger` snippet that spreads the props it receives)
slots.title: Vue: rich title

keyboard: Enter / Space on the trigger open and close
Focus moves into the surface (first focusable, else the surface itself)
Tab moves through the surface and on into the page
Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger
A click or focus outside closes
notes: Labelled by its title and described by its description when present.
Opening and closing from the keyboard are instant.

motion: surface: the shared popup recipe (`popup`): opacity + scale from motion.popup-scale out of the trigger, duration.popup, easing.out-strong; closes at duration.fast; instant from the keyboard
close button: the button's own hover and press (ghost Button)
mounted open (defaultOpen, or open at mount): the surface is drawn at once, with no entrance (data-mounted-open until it first closes); its close, and every later open, animate as above
